structured_output.what_is_happening: Muse Protocol ($Protocol) is a 40-minute-old Solana token trading on a PumpSwap pool. GMGN shows no launchpad and migrated_unix=0, so the pool looks self-seeded rather than a graduated pump.fun curve. In its first hour it traded about $5.9M on a ~$175k market cap and rose about 85%. It uses the name of the current "Muse" AI-agent theme: musebook.lol, musepad.lol and muselawb.lol, where MUSEBOOK is a ~$17M meme token on Robinhood Chain. Its description says "Created on museprotocol.lol", but that domain did not resolve when I fetched it. I found no web or X posts about this contract. The flow data looks artificial: 2,030 unique buyers but only 63 unique sellers making about 3,750 sells, and only 2 GMGN page visits despite $6M of volume.

narrative.description: This rides the Muse AI-agent ecosystem (musebook, a town/BBS of AI 'muses'; musepad, a launchpad for agent tokens; muselawb, a skill marketplace). That ecosystem has real traction: MUSEBOOK is at ~$17M market cap and ~$17M daily volume, though it is down 62% from its high 3 days ago. 'Muse Protocol' presents itself as another piece of that ecosystem, but I found nothing linking museprotocol.lol to the musebook team.
narrative.why_spreading: The parent Muse meta has been live since about 2026-09-17 and is cooling off. This token's own attention looks manufactured (wash-like volume, almost no page visits) rather than organic.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the earliest and largest of three same-name Solana tokens. Its X handle is museprotocollol and its site is museprotocol.lol, neither of which is verified as part of the official musebook/musepad ecosystem. musepad deploys on Robinhood Chain, not on Solana.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Two same-name copies: AttLKd… (~$88k mcap, created ~22 min later) and ARQY3A… (~$53k mcap). There is also an older, unrelated MUSE token (2BvLDW…) and a legacy Muse Protocol music-streaming project with the @museprotocol X account.

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal: 2,030 unique buyers vs 63 unique sellers, with ~3,750 sells. That means a handful of wallets are cycling sells, which looks like wash or bot trading. GMGN: 50 bundler wallets, top bundler traders at 18%, only 2 GMGN page visits despite $6M volume, and no smart-money or KOL wallets. The dev's X account has launched 15 tokens. No organic posts were found anywhere.
authenticity.uncertainty: I have no X post data, and the project site did not resolve. Some of the buyers could be real traders drawn in by the volume.

structural_risks: LP is 0% burned or locked, and RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' as danger plus 'few LP providers'.
The pool looks self-seeded on PumpSwap rather than graduated from the pump.fun curve (no launchpad, migrated_unix 0).
Liquidity (~$272k) is larger than market cap (~$175k): a big SOL deposit the owner can withdraw.
The volume looks like wash trading: 63 sellers against 2,030 buyers.
The dev X account has launched 15 prior tokens; the creator's best token ATH was only ~$181k.

structured_output.counterargument: The Muse AI-agent meta is real and recently produced a $17M token, so a Solana spin-off could attract real speculators. Holder concentration outside the pool is low (top10 about 8.9%), the dev holds almost nothing, and mint and freeze authorities are renounced. The deep liquidity lets size move through, and 2,000+ buyers is a lot. If the self-seeded LP stays in, a move from $175k to $350k market cap is easy in a hot meta.
unknowns: Whether museprotocol.lol is affiliated with the musebook team
Who controls the LP tokens and whether they will be withdrawn
The X account's content and follower authenticity (fetch returned 402)
Whether the unique-seller count is a data artifact

source_coverage.notes: x.com/museprotocollol returned 402. museprotocol.lol gave a DNS failure. Search found the Muse ecosystem (musebook/musepad) but nothing about this contract. The Telegram hits were for the unrelated legacy Muse Protocol.

structured_output.thesis: This is an unaffiliated or unverified spin-off using the name of a cooling Muse AI-agent meta. It sits on a self-seeded PumpSwap pool with unlocked LP, and its volume looks wash-traded (63 sellers against 2k buyers, 2 page visits). That is the classic setup for pulling liquidity after pumping volume, so rug risk is high and a clean 2x from the entry price is unlikely.
